name: Apple iPhone 16 Pro
description: The iPhone 16 Pro features the A18 Pro chip, Apple Intelligence support, Camera Control button, 48MP main/ultrawide/48MP 5x telephoto camera system, and a Super Retina XDR display with ProMotion.

name: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra
description: The Galaxy S25 Ultra combines Snapdragon 8 Elite performance with a 200 MP main camera, integrated titanium S Pen, and AI-powered Galaxy AI features across a 6.9-inch QHD+ display.

images.alt: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra — official front view

name: Google Pixel 9 Pro
description: The Pixel 9 Pro runs on the Tensor G4 chip with a dedicated Titan M2 security coprocessor, offering Google AI capabilities, a 50 MP triple camera system, and satellite connectivity.

name: Apple MacBook Pro 16" (M4 Pro)
description: The MacBook Pro 16" with M4 Pro delivers exceptional performance for professionals with up to 24-core CPU, 40-core GPU, 48 GB unified memory, Liquid Retina XDR display and up to 24 hours battery life.

name: Dell XPS 15 (9530)
description: The Dell XPS 15 9530 combines Intel Core H-series performance with discrete NVIDIA graphics, a stunning OLED or IPS display, and compact premium design for creators and professionals.

name: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12
description: The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12 is an ultra-lightweight business laptop with Intel Core Ultra processors, up to 64 GB LPDDR5X RAM, and enterprise-grade security features in a 1.12 kg chassis.

specs.webcam: 5 MP IR webcam with physical shutter

name: Apple iPhone 16
description: The iPhone 16 brings the A18 chip, Apple Intelligence, Camera Control button, an Action button, and a new 48 MP camera system to the standard model for the first time, with significant AI and connectivity upgrades over its predecessor.

name: Samsung Galaxy S24 FE
description: The Galaxy S24 FE (Fan Edition) delivers Galaxy AI features and a 50 MP triple camera system with Exynos 2500 at an accessible price point with a large 6.7-inch display.

name: OnePlus 13
description: The OnePlus 13 brings the Snapdragon 8 Elite platform, Hasselblad-tuned triple camera system, 100 W SUPERVOOC fast charging and a 6000 mAh battery to flagship class.

name: Xiaomi 14 Pro
description: The Xiaomi 14 Pro features Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, a Leica-partnered triple camera system with a 1-inch main sensor, 120 W HyperCharge fast charging and a curved LTPO AMOLED display.

camera.main: 50 MP Light Fusion X (1-inch sensor), f/1.42, OIS, Leica Vario-Summilux

name: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G14 (2024)
description: The 2024 ROG Zephyrus G14 is a compact gaming powerhouse combining AMD Ryzen 9 8945HS CPU, NVIDIA RTX 4070 with OLED 3K 165 Hz display, in a 1.59 kg premium aluminium chassis.

name: HP Spectre x360 14
description: The HP Spectre x360 14 is a 2-in-1 premium laptop with Intel Core Ultra 7 processor, OLED 2.8K 120 Hz touchscreen, 360-degree hinge and up to 17 hours battery life.

keyboard.layout: HP Premium Keyboard with TilePro fingerprint reader

description: The PlayStation 5 Pro is Sony's mid-generation upgrade to the PS5, featuring a custom 8-core Zen 2+ CPU at 3.85 GHz, a significantly upgraded GPU with 67 enhanced compute units and PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) AI upscaling, targeting 4K 60 fps in games previously running at 1080p or 1440p.

name: ASUS ROG Ally X
description: The ROG Ally X is ASUS's second-generation handheld gaming PC, featuring an AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme APU, 24 GB LPDDR5X RAM (doubled from the original), a 1080p 120 Hz IPS display and a larger 80 Wh battery. It runs Windows 11 and supports the full PC game library via Steam, Xbox Game Pass and Epic.

description: The MacBook Air M4 is Apple's 2025 ultrabook built on the M4 chip (3 nm TSMC N3E), offering a 10-core CPU, up to 10-core GPU, up to 32 GB of unified memory and all-day battery life in a fanless 13.6-inch aluminium chassis.
